title: Polygonal Dinosaur Warm Children's Hat
body_html:
Overview:

In winter, the weather is cold. Your baby should wear a warm and comfortable hat when the temperature is low.
The baby's head occupies almost half of the body's volume. Compared with adults, the head heat dissipation accounts for a larger proportion. So in a cold environment, we should pay attention to wearing a hat for the baby.
